node.label: nephropathic infantile cystinosis
node.definition: Nephropathic infantile cystinosis is the most common and severe form of cystinosis, a metabolic disease characterized by an accumulation of cystine inside the lysosomes that causes damage in different organs and tissues, particularly in the kidneys and eyes.
